Chapter 1231: Chapter 37 Invincible Venerable ’Galaxy’ (Please Subscribe)_2

The other eleven Peak Venerables of the Barbaric Wilderness Country glanced at each other, wondering why they felt a sense of relief.

In the past, during new sacred land contests, the many Peak Venerables from the Barbaric Wilderness Country participated, but ultimately faced failure, leaving them with emotions of dissatisfaction.

However, now, including Man Kun Venerable, the twelve Peak Venerables actually felt fortunate.

Luckily, Man Kun Venerable arrived quickly and communicated well with Galaxy Venerate, thus preserving them.

Otherwise, the fate of the Peak Venerables from the four Ancient Countries, including Da Fu Ancient Country, would be theirs.

The contest for the sacred land, where death and downfall are quite normal; even if Galaxy Venerate hadn’t spared them, there would be no issue.

...

With permission from Galaxy Venerate, the twelve Peak Venerables of the Barbaric Wilderness Country quickly departed towards the sacred land’s entrance.

In the distance, the ten Peak Venerables of Fierce Sun Ancient Country stared at Lin Yuan, feeling somewhat hesitant to approach.

The victory came too easily and unbelievably. Just a moment ago, they felt despair, believing that even if Fierce Sun Ancient Country stood with Barbaric Wilderness Country, the chance of capturing the sacred land was slim against the alliance of Da Fu Ancient Country, Xuanyin Ancient Country, Da Ling Ancient Country, and Thunderclap Ancient Country.

The next moment, all the Peak Venerables from the four Ancient Countries led by Da Fu Ancient Country were effortlessly pushed aside by Galaxy Venerate, showcasing an overwhelming power that shook the hearts of the ten Peak Venerables from Fierce Sun Ancient Country immensely.

"Galaxy Venerate once sparred with me for so long..."

Red Lotus Venerable silently sighed. Before entering the sacred land, he had sparred with Galaxy Venerate, ending in a draw.

Now it seems evident that Galaxy Venerate was merely toying with him.

"Fu Xu Venerate, such a Strongest Venerable, was powerless against Galaxy Venerate. What level of strength does Galaxy Venerate possess now? Is he still the Strongest Venerable?"

Venerable Guanglie and Venerable Hengyang, two top-tier Peak Venerables, were thinking further; ever since the birth of Da Fu Ancient Country, the Strongest Venerable has been the greatest power beneath the Ancestor, the utmost limit for Venerates.

And now, Galaxy Venerate has clearly broken this rule. Calling him the Strongest Venerable no longer seems appropriate.

If Galaxy Venerate is the Strongest Venerable, what are the other Strongest Venerables?

...

Deep within the metropolis of Da Fu.

Many ancient existences were startled; many who had vanished long ago, believed by the outside world to be striving for the Ancestor realm, suddenly opened their eyes, sending forth a sliver of consciousness.

"That Galaxy Venerate?"

Fu Xu Venerate stood among them, with successive scenes flashing by not far away, depicting the spectacle of Galaxy Venerate beginning his overwhelming push from the core pillar in the corner of the sacred land.

Until finally transforming into Fierce Sun, annihilating Fu Xu Venerate along with numerous Peak Venerables.

"Fu Xu, did you lose?"

"With your strength? You actually lost?"

One by one, the ancient Strongest Venerables spoke up. A Strongest Venerable only signifies standing at the pinnacle of Venerate strength, but it doesn’t mean one can’t lose. Yet losing like Fu Xu Venerate was too trivial, wasn’t it?

To lose utterly to Galaxy Venerate? Even after using the Ancient Country’s deepest weapon, still losing?

"Just look."

Fu Xu Venerate’s mind was calm, nearly icy. If he had lost to other Strongest Venerables, he would surely be reflecting and replaying, pondering what he could do better next time.

But losing to Galaxy Venerate?

During the brief exchange, Fu Xu Venerate felt nothing but despair.

His clash with Galaxy Venerate was like an ant trying to shake the sky, with no need to replay it. Even if he tried ten thousand times, a hundred thousand times, Fu Xu Venerate would still lose.

After speaking, Fu Xu Venerate fell silent.

Many ancient Strongest Venerables of Da Fu Ancient Country also began watching the continuous scenes.

In truth, most of the ancient Strongest Venerables started observing the scenes as soon as they arrived; the ones asking questions were doing so incidentally.

Very quickly.

Some ancient Strongest Venerables finished watching all the scenes.

These ancient Strongest Venerables had varied auras, with different paths of Chaos Power development and diverse thirteen-tier Secret Technique inheritances.

Yet after watching the scenes, nearly all the ancient Strongest Venerables fell into silence.

Even though they weren’t directly on the battlefield, merely seeing the scenes from afar, these ancient Strongest Venerables felt an unparalleled sense of oppression from Galaxy Venerate.

"This Galaxy Venerate, his physical body is immensely strong, his fundamental base unfathomably deep, and his Chaos Power development path equally terrifying. Is this the Ancestor bloodline at the Venerate level?"

"Impossible, though the Ancestor bloodline at the Venerate level hasn’t appeared before, it can’t be this strong."

"Indeed, even if the Ancestor bloodline at the Venerate level is strong, it would at most count as a thirteen-tier Secret Technique, equivalent to the level of a Strongest Venerable. Galaxy Venerate’s strength clearly exceeds mere Ancestor bloodline support..."

After a silence, the ancient Strongest Venerables began conversing.

Using the insight at the Strongest Venerables level, they somewhat understood the essence of the bloodline. While the Ancestor bloodline is powerful, it’s merely pure power, whereas Galaxy Venerate’s comprehension of cosmic rules and evolution of Chaos Power far surpassed simple Ancestor bloodlines.

"Debating this now is meaningless."

Just then, one of the Strongest Venerables from Da Fu Ancient Country spoke: "Galaxy Venerate’s strength already fully surpasses ours. Even if we, old timers, shamelessly teamed up against Galaxy Venerate, we would likely be suppressed."

With these words.

The many ancient Strongest Venerables exchanged glances. Although this conclusion was uncomfortable, it was undeniable; Galaxy Venerate’s strength nearly exceeded the Venerate level’s ’boundary’.

"How exactly did Galaxy Venerate cultivate? We believed we’d already trained everything to its utmost, unable to advance any more. How does Galaxy Venerate surpass us so considerably?"

An ancient Strongest Venerable spoke with wonder, pondering why figures like Fu Xu Venerate are known as ’Strongest’ Venerables: because they’ve reached all aspects’ limits, physical body and flesh? Rule comprehension? Chaos evolution path? Mind and willpower?

All approaching the extreme.

But Galaxy Venerate? If not certain that he remains under the Ancestor realm, they might think Lin Yuan has already entered the Ancestor domain.

"In the coming long years, before Galaxy Venerate seeks the Ancestor realm, our Da Fu Ancient Country should minimize conflicts with Fierce Sun Ancient Country."

"Agreed, prohibit any high-intensity warfare; if necessary, ask Ancestors to intercede, but absolutely avoid Galaxy Venerate intervening."

The ancient Strongest Venerables exchanged glances, knowing that if they clashed with Fierce Sun Ancient Country with Galaxy Venerate presiding, it would be self-humiliation.

"Let’s endure; considering Galaxy Venerate’s profound accumulation, he should soon strive for Ancestor levels, easing our burden greatly."

The numerous ancient Strongest Venerables sighed. For Da Fu Ancient Country’s strength, they’ve never felt this constrained before, but there’s no choice; they’re weaker than Galaxy Venerate.

Even if these Strongest Venerables brought Ancient Country’s deep weapon, they couldn’t rival Galaxy Venerate.

"But now, what level exactly is Galaxy Venerate? Still the Strongest Venerable?"

An ancient Strongest Venerable couldn’t help but ask, for if Galaxy is still the Strongest Venerable, then they would all need to take a step back.

Who dares to call themselves ’Strongest Venerables’ alongside Galaxy Venerate?

"Galaxy Venerate should now be called..."

The previously silent Fu Xu Venerate suddenly spoke, his expression vaguely showing complexity: "Invincible Venerate?"

Invincible Venerate!

Once these four words were said.

All Strongest Venerables present felt it exceedingly ’appropriate’.

If Galaxy Venerate isn’t invincible, who is?

The numerous Strongest Venerables glanced at each other, acknowledging this designation.

Galaxy Venerate is the first Invincible Venerate since the founding of the six Ancient Countries, and likely the last.
